docs.title: About Udawalawe Safari
docs.text:
Udawalawe Safari is a locally operated safari service based near Udawalawe National Park, Sri Lanka.

Our goal is to provide ethical, calm, and unforgettable wildlife experiences for travelers from Europe, the United States, and around the world.

docs.title: Our Mission
docs.text:
• Promote responsible wildlife tourism
  • Support local communities
  • Protect Sri Lanka’s natural heritage

docs.title: Why Travelers Trust Us
docs.text:
• Experienced local safari drivers
  • Park-approved 4×4 jeeps
  • Private tours only
  • Clear communication & pricing

See what guests say on our Reviews page.

docs.title: What animals can I see?
docs.text:
Asian elephants, crocodiles, deer, buffalo, jackals, and many bird species.

👉 Full list: Wildlife Guide

docs.title: Is Udawalawe better than Yala?
docs.text: Udawalawe is best for elephants and relaxed safaris. Yala is more crowded and leopard-focused.

docs.title: Is it safe for children?
docs.text: Yes. Udawalawe is one of the safest safari parks in Sri Lanka.

docs.title: Best safari time?
docs.text:
Morning (6:00–10:00 AM) and evening (3:00–6:30 PM).

docs.text: Udawalawe National Park is one of Sri Lanka’s top wildlife destinations.

docs.title: Mammals
docs.text:
• Asian Elephants
  • Leopards
  • Water Buffalo
  • Spotted Deer
  • Jackals

docs.title: Birds
docs.text: Over 200 bird species including eagles, peacocks, owls, and migratory birds.
